threat_scenario: Attacker floods the bus with high-priority frames
recommended_action: Rate-limit/kill flood source; isolate bus segment

threat_scenario: Attacker forges speed signal on a legitimate ID
damage_scenario: Incorrect speed drives unsafe control decisions
recommended_action: Reject forged frames; enforce message authentication (HMAC)
Drop unknown IDs; enforce ID allow-list / IDS filtering

threat_scenario: False grid/charging data injected during charging
damage_scenario: Overcharge risk / charging session and grid disruption
recommended_action: Reject false telemetry; secure charging session (encryption)
Reject stale frames; enforce freshness counters/nonces
Reject implausible values; enforce integrity checks (HMAC)
